title: Cloud Economics implementation facts and architectural prohibitions

records.rule: PAPER_ONLY; no live purchase, deployment, payment or cancellation commands.
Market price != capacity == no purchase authority.
Registry count 23; working configured observers are a smaller subset and public readings are not booked capacity.
Two 32 GiB offers are only a candidate 64 GiB segmented-memory plan with native Memory Fabric acceptance, never a contiguous 64 GiB claim.
Find cheapest valid completion of the intention, not lowest per-hour VM.
Hard eligibility precedes optimization; allocator/WLU/native lease authority remains external.
Stay/move comparison uses future marginal charges, billing floors, checkpoint and route overhead; never includes sunk costs as prospective saving.
migratable.job.status/1 observation cannot prove lease, real execution, migration commit, invoice, or spending authority.
SQLite hash chain is local evidence integrity, NOT authenticated authority; redelivery/stale/identity conflict semantics are fail-closed.
Balanced paper postings demonstrate simulated economic decisions, not provider invoices or company books.
model forecast != paper commitment != measured usage != invoiced charge != realized saving.
Establish comparable unmanaged plan pre-decision, match performance/period/service/perimeter; if unavailable mark SAVINGS_UNKNOWN.
Default ooRexx numeric precision may round transfer bytes; external exact counters required for invoice settlement.
Dev8 simple statistical extrapolator has no independently backtested learned-model qualification.
Native ooRexx regressions were not rerun for dev8; independent sphere Gopher qualification is pending.
